LanguageData.HospitalConditionCuredExternally: {0} no longer needs the operation - the condition has been cured.
LanguageData.HospitalPatientDiedNoPenalty: {0} died. Not your fault, so {1}'s goodwill is unchanged.
LanguageData.BlacklistHint: Checked entries are blacklisted and will not appear.
LanguageData.HospitalDrugPoliciesTooltip: Drug policy entries with "Scheduled" enabled are administered by doctors as medical bills placed before other bills. The entry's frequency, mood and joy limits apply. Policies are edited in the drug policy manager.
LanguageData.HospitalDrugListTooltip: Drug policy given to patients of this kind. Patients get the drugs of every list that applies to them.
LanguageData.HospitalDrugTeetotalersTooltip: Also give this list's drugs to teetotalers. When unchecked, teetotaler patients skip this list.
LanguageData.AcceptPatientsTooltip: uncheck this if you want to stop patients from visiting
LanguageData.AcceptSurgeryTooltip: uncheck this if you do not want to get surgery events
LanguageData.AcceptAggressiveTooltip: Challenge. Needs "Accept surgery". Patients may arrive needing a cure for an aggression-causing condition (e.g. scaria). Their faction sedates them for transport; if the cure does not come in time, they wake up berserk and your colonists must deal with them. Sedation lasts {0} hours (set in the mod settings).
LanguageData.AcceptDangerTooltip: check this if you want to override the check if the map if safe for patients to arrive
LanguageData.MceAcceptDangerTooltip: check this to let mass casualty events happen while the map is dangerous (e.g. manhunters). Uncheck to make them wait for a safe map. Weather dangers are still controlled by "Allow patients during danger".
LanguageData.SilverMultiplierTooltip: Changes the patients bill by this percentage. (recommended: 100%)
LanguageData.GoodwillGainMultiplierTooltip: Scales the goodwill earned from happy patients leaving. (default: 100%)
LanguageData.DeathGoodwillPenaltyTooltip: Goodwill lost with a faction when one of their patients dies. Applies to deaths you are responsible for (killed by your colonists, turrets or animals, or died of illness, blood loss or failed surgery) unless "Penalize deaths not caused by me" is ticked. (default: 10)
LanguageData.PenalizeNonPlayerDeaths: Penalize deaths not caused by me
LanguageData.PenalizeNonPlayerDeathsTooltip: Unticked (default): the death penalty applies only when your faction killed the patient or the patient died with no killer (illness, blood loss, failed surgery). Deaths caused by raiders, wild or manhunting animals, enemy mechs or the environment cost no goodwill. Ticked: every patient death costs goodwill. Known gap: a patient who bleeds out after an animal attack has no killer attached, so that death still counts.
LanguageData.SurgeryFailGoodwillPenaltyTooltip: Goodwill lost with a faction when a surgery on their patient fails. (default: 1)
LanguageData.DiseaseSeverityMultiplierTooltip: Scales how severe arriving patients' diseases are. Higher is harder. (default: 100%)
LanguageData.WoundSeverityMultiplierTooltip: Scales how badly wounded arriving patients are. Higher is harder. (default: 100%)
LanguageData.SedationHoursTooltip: How long an aggressive patient stays sedated after arriving, before turning berserk if not cured. Only used when "Allow aggressive patients" is on. (default: 8)
LanguageData.PatientSedatedWarning: Sedated by their faction. They wake up in about {0} hours and will turn berserk unless cured first.
LanguageData.BedsReservedTooltip: To make sure your beds are not all filled up with patients
LanguageData.ShowMessageAtArrivalTooltip: Shows as a message instead of a letter when a new patient arrives.
LanguageData.PreventIncapacitatedArrivalsTooltip: Patients stop being wounded just before they would collapse, so they arrive hurt but still able to walk. Disable for tougher mass casualty events with downed patients you must rescue.
LanguageData.MassCasualtiesTooltip: A MCE will sporadically overwhelm your hospital with patients.
LanguageData.CommandBedSetAsHospitalDesc: Whether this bed is for patients.
LanguageData.CommandBedSetAsSurgeryDesc: Whether this bed is for surgery patients.
